pre_formal_amendments: evaluation_seed=165 was fixed after smoke-only training and before any formal baseline training or evaluation
ACTrajNet single-aircraft scenes are vectorized only within each official nine-scene gradient accumulation group; optimizer update count and summed per-scene loss are unchanged
TrajAirNet is trained and evaluated on manifest-backed reconstructed social scenes; per-aircraft no-social files are reserved for ACTrajNet
Official model calls are grouped by equal scene actor count with torch.vmap only inside each nine-scene optimizer group; each social scene retains its own GAT and latent sample

trajairnet.implementation: unmodified official model modules through a local deterministic training adapter

actrajnet.implementation: unmodified official CAF-TCN model modules through a local deterministic training adapter

training.checkpoint: fixed final epoch; TrajAirNet epoch-10 is a separately labelled README snapshot
training.official_call_vectorization: torch.vmap with independent randomness over equal-actor-count scenes inside each nine-scene optimizer group

evaluation.probabilities: uniform empirical measure over the five fixed-seed samples

comparison_boundary.native_protocol_table: TrajAirNet and ACTrajNet are retrained in-domain with 11 observed points and 12 forecast points; frozen MABPT is evaluated zero-shot with its native 16 observations and 24 forecast points.
comparison_boundary.aligned_target_table: A separate common-window evaluator uses the same t+10,...,t+120 targets. It reports both native MABPT history and an observation-11 padding sensitivity arm.
comparison_boundary.data_budget: The native official baselines and zero-shot MABPT do not have matched training data budgets; E7-E8 provide parameter and compute controls only against ASCENT.
comparison_boundary.evidence_class: retrospective external/cross-dataset reuse, not a fresh sealed confirmation

known_source_discrepancies: The TrajAirNet paper states Adam with learning rate 1e-4, while the current train.py default is 1e-3.
The TrajAirNet README describes 10 epochs, while the current train.py default is 50; both fixed snapshots are retained without test selection.
The ACTrajNet paper states 50 epochs and learning rate 1e-4, while the current train.py default is 1e-5.
Both official test scripts choose the lowest-ADE random sample. The MABPT evaluation instead reports the full uniform five-sample measure and labels oracle metrics explicitly.
